title: Preparation of Total Cell Lysates
author: Sarah van Veen
materials: Determine protein concentration via BCA assay.

steps.title: Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Seed cells into a 10 cm dish at a density appropriate to achieve 70–80% confluence by the following day and allow them to attach and grow for approximately 24 hours.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the cells from the dish using TrypLE.

steps.title: Wash Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the collected cells with DPBS to remove residual TrypLE.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 400 x g, 4 °C
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 400 x g, 4 °C

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Lysis of the cell pellet using RIPA buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add RIPA lysis buffer supplemented with protease inhibitors
Incubate for at least 30 minutes on ice (alternatively, store at -20 °C until further processing)

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate to remove insoluble material.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15,000 x g, 4 °C for 30 minutes to pellet DNA and non-solubilized material
